nodes.label: Hybrid git-based versioning
nodes.rationale: File mtime versioning was non-deterministic and untraceable; hybrid tag/commit injection gives same commit = same version, traceability to the exact commit, semantic versions on releases, and no manual updates.

nodes.label: IP cache fallback mechanism
nodes.rationale: Prevents initialization failures caused by rate limiting or IP bans: multi-layered fallback with service rotation, exponential-backoff retries, and local TTL caching so a dead identity pool degrades to cached IPs instead of error_exit.
